name: InterContinental Phu Quoc Long Beach Resort
positioning: Beach resort on the Vietnamese island of Phu Quoc, between the ocean and jungle-clad hills, with resort-wing rooms, Sky Tower residences and beachfront villas
best_for: Families who want several pools, water slides and kids activities on a beach
Couples looking for a lagoon-side spa and a rooftop bar with ocean views
Groups who want a multi-bedroom villa or residence

facts.text: The resort is on the tropical Vietnamese island of Phu Quoc, where the ocean meets jungle-clad hills.
Accommodation spans rooms and suites in the resort wings, residences in the Sky Tower and beachfront villas.
The resort has two main outdoor pools for adults, two children's pools with water slides, and a pool for Club InterContinental guests.
The beach has chairs, umbrellas, towel service and cabanas for rent.
LAVA restaurant has a facade built from local materials by architect Vo Trong Nghia.
Sea Shack is a beachfront restaurant inspired by the traditional architecture of local fishing villages.
Kids services include children's activities on site, babysitting and a nanny for hire.
Breakfast is included with a stay.
The hotel holds EDGE Advanced third-party sustainability certification.
Beachfront wedding ceremonies can be planned at the resort.
Phu Quoc International Airport is about 12 kilometers from the resort.

highlights.text: HARNN Heritage Spa has treatment suites that appear to float on the Lotus Lagoon, with therapies inspired by traditional Asian healing.
INK 360, the rooftop bar designed by Ashley Sutton, has panoramic ocean views from the 19th floor.
All accommodations have views of the ocean, the green mountains, gardens or lagoons.
The Four Bedroom Villa may include an outdoor private pool, an oceanfront position and beach access.

considerations.text: Some island sights need a drive: Ho Quoc Pagoda is a 30-minute drive from the resort.
Pets are not allowed at the resort.
WhataHotel notes the remote island location requires flight connections.
